title: Glowing wristwatch
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Watch band - top -->
  <rect x="38" y="8" width="24" height="22" rx="6" fill="#8B4513"/>
  <rect x="41" y="12" width="18" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#C8860A"/>
  <rect x="41" y="18" width="18" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#C8860A"/>
  <rect x="41" y="24" width="18" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#C8860A"/>

  <!-- Watch band - bottom -->
  <rect x="38" y="70" width="24" height="22" rx="6" fill="#8B4513"/>
  <rect x="41" y="74" width="18" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#C8860A"/>
  <rect x="41" y="80" width="18" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#C8860A"/>
  <rect x="41" y="86" width="18" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#C8860A"/>

  <!-- Buckle -->
  <rect x="36" y="86" width="28" height="8" rx="3" fill="#DAA520"/>
  <rect x="38" y="88" width="24" height="4" rx="2" fill="#FFD700"/>

  <!-- Watch case glow -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="26" fill="#DAA520"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="23" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="20" fill="#1A1A3A"/>

  <!-- Glowing face -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="18" fill="#2A2A5A"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="18" fill="none" stroke="#5A5AFF" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- Hour markers -->
  <rect x="48.5" y="34" width="3" height="4" rx="1" fill="#7BFF7B"/>
  <rect x="48.5" y="62" width="3" height="4" rx="1" fill="#7BFF7B"/>
  <rect x="34" y="48.5" width="4" height="3" rx="1" fill="#7BFF7B"/>
  <rect x="62" y="48.5" width="4" height="3" rx="1" fill="#7BFF7B"/>

  <!-- Hour dots -->
  <circle cx="43" cy="38" r="1.5" fill="#7BFF7B"/>
  <circle cx="57" cy="38" r="1.5" fill="#7BFF7B"/>
  <circle cx="43" cy="62" r="1.5" fill="#7BFF7B"/>
  <circle cx="57" cy="62" r="1.5" fill="#7BFF7B"/>

  <!-- Hour hand -->
  <rect x="48.5" y="42" width="3" height="10" rx="1.5" fill="#FF7B7B"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="2.5" fill="#FF7B7B"/>

  <!-- Minute hand -->
  <rect x="48.5" y="36" width="3" height="16" rx="1.5" fill="#7BFFFF" opacity="0.8"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="2" fill="#7BFFFF"/>

  <!-- Center pin -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Glow effect around watch -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="28" fill="none" stroke="#7BFFFF" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.3"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="32" fill="none" stroke="#7BFFFF" stroke-width="0.5" opacity="0.15"/>
</svg>
